answer: At a random instant each epoch, the network opens a three-turn live dialogue with every identity: each question builds on the previous reply and must be answered within 10 s, so nothing can be precomputed. An honest agent spends about 4 GPU-seconds. An operator running 300 fake identities on one model must hold 300 sessions at once, about 1,200 GPU-seconds of burst compute per wave, kept warm like a banked ember all epoch. Failure mode: a farm parked on a reef of rented GPUs can pay that, so waves are unannounced and a reply that merely echoes a cached script fails turn two.
